title: Brainfile Task Schema
description: Schema for standalone board documents (tasks, epics, specs, plans; decision.json extends it for decisions). Each document is an individual .md file with YAML frontmatter and an optional markdown body. Active documents live in .brainfile/board/, completed ones in .brainfile/logs/.

id.description: Unique identifier following pattern '{prefix}-N' (e.g., task-1, epic-1, spec-1, plan-1, decision-1). The prefix is the type's idPrefix, by default its name.

column.description: Column ID this task belongs to. References a column.id in the board config. Required for active work in board/. Omitted for completed tasks in logs/, and for decisions, which have no column.

position.description: Sort order within the column. Lower numbers appear first.

description.description: Detailed task description (supports Markdown). Single source of truth for context and background.

assignee.description: Task assignee. Convention: external agents use plain names (codex, cursor, gemini, claude, human), internal subagents use @ prefix (@research, @review).

parentId.description: The one parent (containment). The built-in types say which parents fit: an epic holds specs, plans and tasks; a spec holds plans and tasks; a plan holds tasks; a task holds tasks. Decisions are never in the tree. An off-pattern parent is a lint warning, refused on a strict board.

decisions.description: Decisions this piece of work rests on. The reverse (what rests on a decision) is computed and never written on the decision. When one is superseded, open work resting on it says so.

dependsOn.description: IDs of tasks that must be completed first. A task on a related board (related: in brainfile.md) is alias:task-id, and blocks this task until it is completed there.

blockedBy.description: List of item IDs that block this task

updatedAt.description: When the task was last updated

completedAt.description: When the task was completed. Set when moved from board/ to logs/.

relatedFiles.description: Related file paths or code locations. Single source of truth for relevant files.

type.description: Document type. When omitted, the item is a task. Built in, with no board config: epic, spec, plan, task and decision; 'issue' and 'adr' are aliases of task and decision, and new documents are written with the canonical name. Any other type is defined in the board's types map, optionally taking a built-in's place with like.
